description: Abstract base class for JMeter client components connecting to Hono, providing setup and teardown of Vertx instances with specific configurations.

classes.name: AbstractClient
classes.description: Base abstract class providing common Vertx setup and lifecycle management for clients connecting to Hono.

methods.name: vertx()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vertx instance with specific DNS and warning configurations.

methods.name: closeVertx()
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance asynchronously, returning a Future that completes upon closure.
